jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Core Experience
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIN CAN

Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. We're creating screen-free, delightful devices and services that let families call the people who matter most, free from the noise of today's digital world.

We're building a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler & better for their kids than the tech-infused lives we're currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it).




THE ROLE

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to drive retention: getting families off to a great start with Tin Can and keeping kids calling the people who matter, week after week. It's arguably the highest-leverage product problem we have, and right now no one's running it full-time.

This role spans more of the product than most PM jobs. Driving connection might mean improving the app one week, rethinking how voicemail works, or proposing a new accessory the next. You'll work closely with the Head of Product to set direction on retention, and you'll own execution end to end — building the backlog, shipping the work, and using what you learn to propose what's next. As you prove out the area, we expect your ownership of strategy to grow. You'll partner closely with the founding team, engineering, brand, and marketing. This is a hands-on role for someone who cares deeply about user experience and knows how to balance rigor with momentum.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Find the highest-leverage ways to drive consistent calling — the rituals that keep families coming back — and go make them happen

 - Turn broad goals into clear hypotheses and a focused product backlog

 - Do whatever the problem needs: write the test plan and run it yourself, draft the in-app and email copy, work with engineering to spec the fix

 - Design and ship product that builds durable calling rituals in partnership with engineering

 - Sweat the first-run and week-one experience, the moments that make Tin Can stick

 - Design and build instrumentation to see whether you’re moving the needle

 - Run experiments, synthesize learnings, and decide what to scale, iterate on, or stop

 - Collaborate with leadership to align your work with overall product strategy and values

 - Sharpen the processes and norms that help the team ship and learn faster

 - Pitch in across the product surface when needed, while continuing to own your area




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years of deep consumer product experience, ideally on an adjacent product — bonus for hardware + software, or for building for a kid and a parent at once

 - A track record of moving retention or engagement metrics, not just shipping features

 - Strong product instincts paired with analytical rigor and comfort with data

 - Fluency using AI as a multiplier across discovery, prototyping, and analysis — this is how we work, not a nice-to-have

 - Excellent judgment around user trust, quality, and long-term tradeoffs, especially building for kids and the parents who trust us

 - Ability to move work forward with little oversight, while partnering on strategy

 - Clear communication and the ability to tell a compelling story about what you're learning and why it matters

 - Hands-on and scrappy approach; you'd rather write the copy or dig into the bug yourself than wait on someone else

 - Low-ego and collaborative vibes; you share credit and pitch in on problems that aren't yours




WHY JOIN TIN CAN

 - We're building tech that protects childhood: We're on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. No doomscrolling, data mining, or dopamine traps — just a simpler, better way for kids to stay in touch. This is a rare opportunity to build something that truly matters.

 - You'll own how we get there: Retention is one of our most important bets, and you'll drive it — building the backlog, running real experiments, and shaping strategy alongside the Head of Product. You'll see your work change how families use Tin Can, and you’ll have the opportunity to shape our direction.

 - Small, high-trust team: Every company says "team," but at Tin Can it means something different. We're a small, mission-driven group that genuinely has each other's backs — professionally and personally. You'll be joining a tight-knit crew where your ideas and instincts matter from day one.

 - Room to explore, not just execute: You'll have the space to explore new ideas, challenge assumptions, and shape a product experience that reflects our values of trust, simplicity, and care.

If you're excited by the idea of taking a product families already love and making it something they can't imagine living without, please reach out. We can't wait to meet someone who's ready to jump in, own a goal that matters, and help us grow.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Reliability & Call Quality

THE ROLE

If the Tin Can doesn't work when you pick up the phone, nothing else matters. A call that drops, crackles, or won't connect isn't a small bug — we’ve broken our promise to families. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own two things end to end: getting devices reliably connected, and making every call sound clear, no matter what router, room, or Wi-Fi setup we’re up against.

This is a technical, hands-on role. You'll dig into how our devices handle mesh networks and dual-band Wi-Fi to solve connectivity, and work directly with firmware engineers on the audio path — echo, packet loss, static, volume — to solve quality. You'll figure out where the real failures are happening (in the field, in the data, in a call that just doesn't sound right) and push whatever path will fix it, whether that's hardware, firmware, or a partnership with a router company. You'll partner closely with engineering and the Head of Product, and you'll be the person in the room who can go as deep as the problem requires.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own reliability and call quality as a first-class problem, finding and fixing problems

 - Work with firmware engineers to run down issues that contribute to sound degradation

 - Flag when a fix needs to go beyond firmware, helping shape the hardware roadmap

 - Understand and improve how devices connect and stay online

 - Test partnerships to see if we can move the needle faster together

 - Build instrumentation and reporting to measure quality, qualitatively and quantitatively

 - Turn diagnosis into a clear, prioritized backlog engineering can actually execute against

 - Run tests yourself, using a mix of field and internal testing to get a real answer

 - Report clearly on what's improving, what isn't, and what's next




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management experience with connected hardware or IoT products, plus real depth in audio or telecom/VoIP quality

 - Genuine technical fluency in networking and audio; you can hold your own in a conversation about jitter, packet loss, or dual-band handoff

 - Someone comfortable digging into logs and firmware behavior to find the root cause

 - Experience partnering closely with firmware or embedded engineering teams

 - A clear communicator; you can translate a deep technical problem into a plan non-engineers can follow

 - Hands-on and scrappy approach; you'd rather run the test or dig into the logs yourself than wait on someone else

You'll see your work change how families use Tin Can, and you’ll have the opportunity to shape our direction.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Acquisition & Brand
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIN CAN

Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. We're creating screen-free, delightful devices and services that let families call the people who matter most, free from the noise of today's digital world.

We're building a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler & better for their kids than the tech-infused lives we're currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it).




THE ROLE

We're seeking a super-creative (and whacky) Product Manager to drive new customer acquisition and bring brand initiatives to life.

This role requires both analytical and creative horsepower. The "product" you own lives on and off the screen. One day you might map out all the technical systems that need to integrate with a new referral sharing software, and the next you'll help figure out the most rad friendship-bracelet referral reward program and how to get it in kids' hands (err, wrist). You have great taste, you’re not afraid to be bold, and you know how to bring things onto the screen and into real life, no matter what it takes. You’re not just a dreamer, you’re a doer.

Working closely with our Creative, Brand, and Growth Marketing teams is a core (and extremely fun) part of this role. The perfect candidate loves to help turn pie-in-the-sky ideas into reality, while balancing the myriad of possibilities against realities of the business. You say yes more than no, but still, you know when to say no.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own our referral program, making it a core component of our growth engine

 - Build a kid-to-kid sharing program so Tin Can gets hyped everywhere they go, and the best way to reach them is in the real (non-digital) world

 - Give Growth Marketing the tools and systems to move fast, from landing pages to attribution

 - Support bringing brand campaigns and experiences to life, on and off the screen, from concept through execution

 - Be a partner to Brand, shaping ambitious ideas with them, not just executing on their behalf

 - Align Creative, Growth Marketing, and Engineering on what's next, stitching dreams into reality

 - Get scrappy when the job calls for it — whatever it takes to make something real
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management experience, ideally with experience in growth or brand; bonus points for work with a brand that gets it

 - You get ish done, rallying diverse groups, finding resources, keeping everyone on track

 - Crystal clear communication, from prank call campaigns to attribution pipelines

 - Experience collaborating closely with designers, creatives, and supply chain teams

 - Excellent visual taste; you know something's great the moment you see it (we call it razzle-dazzle) (jk, nobody actually calls it that)

 - Technical and data fluency — you get numbers, think in systems, understand scaling

 - Fluency using AI as a multiplier in your work; this is how we work, not a nice-to-have

 - Ownership mindset — you're a PM, but also a "call everywhere in Seattle to estimate sticker cost"-er when it counts

 - Low ego, high enthusiasm — you cheer as loud for someone else's idea as your own
   
   


WHY JOIN TIN CAN

 - We're building tech that protects childhood: We're on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. No doomscrolling, data mining, or dopamine traps — just a simpler, better way for kids to stay in touch. This is a rare opportunity to build something that truly matters.

 - You'll turn pie-in-the-sky into real life: Acquisition and brand are where some of our wildest ideas get made real, and you'll be the one making it happen, with real ownership over how you get there.

 - Small, high-trust team: Every company says "team," but at Tin Can it means something different. We're a small, mission-driven group that genuinely has each other's backs — professionally and personally. You'll be joining a tight-knit crew where your ideas and instincts matter from day one.

 - Room to explore, not just execute: You'll have the space to explore new ideas, challenge assumptions, and shape a product experience that reflects our values of trust, simplicity, and care.

If you're excited by the idea of turning a wild idea into something kids actually beg for, please reach out. We can't wait to meet someone who's ready to jump in, make things happen, and help us grow.
